note: 聽力測驗要求:依官方大綱逐項整理(文字為摘要,不是原文)。drills = App 能產生並批改的練習;沒有 drills 的項目(看譜唱、描述風格等)只列出要求。

abrsm.name: ABRSM
abrsm.syllabusNote: 2027 & 2028 版聽力測驗文字逐字比對過,完全相同

tests.zh: 跟著考官彈的曲子拍出拍子(盡快加入、保持穩定)
tests.en: Clap the pulse of a piece, joining in as soon as possible

tests.zh: 拍出兩個節奏回聲:兩小節、三或四拍子、只有旋律;先數兩小節,聽完馬上接著拍
tests.en: Clap back two 2-bar rhythm echoes (3 or 4 time) in time, after a 2-bar count-in

tests.zh: 唱出兩個回聲:一小節、4/4、大調、主音到中音;先聽主和弦與主音,數兩小節
tests.en: Sing back two 1-bar echoes (4/4, major, tonic–mediant) after key-chord, tonic and count-in

tests.zh: 回答曲子的一個特徵:力度(大聲/小聲)或奏法(圓滑/斷開)
tests.en: Answer about one feature: dynamics (loud/quiet) or articulation (smooth/detached)

tests.zh: 拍出拍子(強拍拍大聲),並回答是二拍子還是三拍子
tests.en: Clap the pulse (stressing strong beats) and say if it is in two or three time

tests.zh: 唱出三個回聲:兩小節、大調、主音到中音
tests.en: Sing back three 2-bar echoes (major, tonic–mediant)

tests.zh: 兩小節樂句(大調)彈兩次,第二次改了一個音:改變在開頭附近還是結尾附近
tests.en: A 2-bar major phrase is played twice with one note changed: near the beginning or near the end?

tests.zh: 回答兩個特徵:力度(大聲/小聲、突然/漸漸改變)與奏法(圓滑/斷開)
tests.en: Two features: dynamics (loud/quiet, sudden/gradual changes) and articulation

tests.zh: 拍出拍子,並回答是二拍子還是三拍子
tests.en: Clap the pulse and say if it is in two or three time

tests.zh: 唱出三個回聲:兩小節、大調、主音到屬音
tests.en: Sing back three 2-bar echoes (major, tonic–dominant)

tests.zh: 兩小節樂句(大調)彈兩次,第二次有改變:是音高還是節奏改了
tests.en: A 2-bar major phrase played twice: was the change in pitch or rhythm?

tests.zh: 回答兩個特徵:力度或奏法,以及速度(變慢/變快/不變)
tests.en: Two features: dynamics or articulation, then tempo (slower/faster/same)

tests.zh: 拍出拍子,並回答是二、三還是四拍子
tests.en: Clap the pulse and say if it is in two, three or four time

tests.zh: 唱出三個回聲:兩小節、大調或小調、一個八度以內
tests.en: Sing back three 2-bar echoes (major or minor, within an octave)

tests.zh: 最多四小節的樂句(大調或小調)彈兩次:音高還是節奏改了
tests.en: A phrase of up to 4 bars (major or minor) played twice: pitch or rhythm change?

tests.zh: 回答兩個特徵:力度、奏法或速度,以及調性(大調/小調)
tests.en: Two features: dynamics, articulation or tempo, then tonality (major/minor)

tests.zh: 旋律彈兩次,唱出或彈出來(一個八度以內,大調或小調,最多三個升降記號)
tests.en: Sing or play back a melody heard twice (octave range, major/minor, up to 3 sharps/flats)

tests.zh: 看譜唱五個音(C、F、G 大調,主音上下三度以內)
tests.en: Sight-sing five notes (C, F or G major, within a third of the tonic)

tests.zh: (i) 回答兩個特徵:力度、奏法、速度或調性,以及性格;(ii) 拍出片段的節奏,並回答二、三或四拍子
tests.en: (i) Two features — dynamics, articulation, tempo or tonality, then character; (ii) clap the rhythm of an extract and name two, three or four time

tests.zh: 旋律彈兩次,唱出或彈出來(一個八度以內,大調或小調,最多三個升降記號)
tests.en: Sing or play back a melody heard twice (octave range, major/minor, up to 3 sharps/flats)

tests.zh: 看譜唱六個音(最多兩個升降記號的大調)
tests.en: Sight-sing six notes (major key, up to 2 sharps/flats)

tests.zh: (i) 回答兩個特徵:力度、奏法、速度、調性或性格,以及風格與時期;(ii) 拍出片段的節奏,並回答二、三或四拍子
tests.en: (i) Two features, then style and period; (ii) clap the rhythm of an extract and name two, three or four time

tests.zh: 兩聲部樂句彈兩次,唱出或彈出上聲部(一個八度以內)
tests.en: Sing or play back the upper part of a two-part phrase heard twice

tests.zh: 看譜唱一段旋律,考官彈伴奏
tests.en: Sing a melody from score with an accompaniment

tests.zh: 樂句結尾的終止式:完全或不完全(原位和弦,彈兩次)
tests.en: Identify the cadence as perfect or imperfect (root-position chords, played twice)

tests.zh: (i) 回答兩個特徵:織體或曲式,以及另一項;(ii) 拍出片段的節奏,並回答二、三或四拍子
tests.en: (i) Two features — texture or structure, then another; (ii) clap an extract's rhythm and name two, three or four time

tests.zh: 兩聲部樂句彈兩次,唱出或彈出下聲部(一個八度以內)
tests.en: Sing or play back the lower part of a two-part phrase heard twice

tests.zh: 看譜唱兩聲部的上聲部,考官彈下聲部
tests.en: Sing the upper part of a two-part phrase from score

tests.zh: (i) 終止式:完全、不完全或阻礙;(ii) 這個終止式的兩個和弦(I、IV、V、V7、vi,原位);(iii) 從大調轉到屬調、下屬調或關係小調
tests.en: (i) Cadence: perfect, imperfect or interrupted; (ii) its two chords (I, IV, V, V7, vi); (iii) modulation from a major key to dominant, subdominant or relative minor

tests.zh: (i) 回答兩個特徵(力度、奏法、速度、調性、性格、風格與時期、織體、曲式);(ii) 拍出片段的節奏,並回答二、三、四或 6/8 拍
tests.en: (i) Two features; (ii) clap an extract's rhythm and name two, three, four or 6/8 time

tests.zh: (i) 三聲部樂句彈兩次,唱出或彈出最低聲部;(ii) 終止式:完全、不完全、阻礙或變格;(iii) 終止進行的三個和弦(含轉位)
tests.en: (i) Sing/play back the lowest part of a three-part phrase; (ii) cadence: perfect, imperfect, interrupted or plagal; (iii) its three chords with positions

tests.zh: 看譜唱兩聲部的下聲部,考官彈上聲部
tests.en: Sing the lower part of a two-part phrase from score

tests.zh: 兩段轉調(一段從大調、一段從小調開始):屬調、下屬調或關係大/小調
tests.en: Two modulations (from a major and from a minor key): dominant, subdominant or relative

tests.zh: 描述曲子的特徵(織體、曲式、性格、風格與時期等)
tests.en: Describe the characteristic features of a piece

trinity.name: Trinity
trinity.syllabus: Piano Syllabus — Qualification specifications for graded exams from 2023 (Supporting tests: Aural)
trinity.syllabusNote: 所有問題都根據考官在鋼琴上彈的一段音樂;不用唱

grades.params: 旋律、4 小節、大調、2 拍

tests.zh: 聽三次,第三次拍出拍子(強拍加重)
tests.en: Clap the pulse on the third playing, stressing the strong beat

tests.zh: 聽一次:力度是 forte 還是 piano
tests.en: Dynamic: forte or piano?

tests.zh: 聽一次:奏法是圓滑還是斷奏
tests.en: Articulation: legato or staccato?

tests.zh: 聽前三個音:哪一個最高 / 最低
tests.en: First three notes: which is highest / lowest?

grades.params: 旋律、4 小節、大調、2 或 3 拍
grades.paramsEn: Melody only · 4 bars · major · 2 or 3 time

tests.zh: 聽三次,第三次拍出拍子(強拍加重)
tests.en: Clap the pulse on the third playing, stressing the strong beat

tests.zh: 聽一次:(i) forte 還是 piano;(ii) 圓滑還是斷奏
tests.en: (i) Forte or piano; (ii) legato or staccato

tests.zh: 聽前兩小節:最後一個音比第一個音高還是低
tests.en: First two bars: is the last note higher or lower than the first?

tests.zh: 聽兩次,第二次改了節奏或音高:改在哪裡
tests.en: Played twice with a rhythm or pitch change: where is it?

grades.params: 旋律、4 小節、大調或小調、2 或 3 拍
grades.paramsEn: Melody only · 4 bars · major or minor · 2 or 3 time

tests.zh: 聽三次,第三次拍出拍子(強拍加重)
tests.en: Clap the pulse on the third playing, stressing the strong beat

tests.zh: 聽一次:(i) 描述力度的變化;(ii) 圓滑還是斷奏
tests.en: (i) Describe the changing dynamics; (ii) legato or staccato

tests.zh: 聽一次:最後一個音比第一個音高還是低
tests.en: Is the last note higher or lower than the first?

tests.zh: 聽兩次,第二次有改變:(i) 改在哪裡;(ii) 是節奏還是音高
tests.en: Played twice with a change: (i) where; (ii) rhythm or pitch?

grades.params: 旋律、4 小節、大調或小調、3 或 4 拍
grades.paramsEn: Melody only · 4 bars · major or minor · 3 or 4 time

tests.zh: 聽兩次,第二次拍出拍子(強拍加重)
tests.en: Clap the pulse on the second playing, stressing the strong beat

tests.zh: 聽一次:大調還是小調
tests.en: Tonality: major or minor?

tests.zh: 聽前兩個音:音程是幾度(只說度數:二到六度)
tests.en: First two notes: interval by number only (2nd–6th)

tests.zh: 看樂譜、聽兩次(一次照譜、一次有改變):(i) 第幾小節;(ii) 節奏還是音高
tests.en: With the score, heard as written then changed: (i) which bar; (ii) rhythm or pitch?

grades.params: 有和聲、4 小節、大調或小調、4 或 6 拍
grades.paramsEn: Harmonised · 4 bars · major or minor · 4 or 6 time

tests.zh: 聽兩次,第二次拍出拍子(強拍加重)
tests.en: Clap the pulse on the second playing, stressing the strong beat

tests.zh: 聽兩次:(i) 大調還是小調;(ii) 結尾終止式是完全還是不完全
tests.en: (i) Major or minor; (ii) final cadence perfect or imperfect?

tests.zh: 聽前兩個音:大小二度、大小三度、完全四/五度、大小六度
tests.en: First two notes: m/M 2nd, m/M 3rd, P4, P5, m/M 6th

tests.zh: 看樂譜、聽兩次(一次照譜、一次改了節奏和音高):(i) 節奏改在第幾小節;(ii) 音高改在第幾小節
tests.en: With the score, heard as written then with a rhythm and a pitch change: which bar for each?

grades.params: 有和聲、8 小節、大調或小調、2/3/4/6 拍
grades.paramsEn: Harmonised · 8 bars · major or minor · 2, 3, 4 or 6 time

tests.zh: 聽兩次:(i) 第二次拍出拍子;(ii) 拍號
tests.en: (i) Clap the pulse on the second playing; (ii) time signature

tests.zh: 聽兩次:(i) 調性怎麼改變;(ii) 終止式:完全、變格、不完全或阻礙
tests.en: (i) The changing tonality; (ii) cadence: perfect, plagal, imperfect or interrupted

tests.zh: 旋律中連續兩個音的音程:大小二到七度、完全四/五度、八度
tests.en: Two consecutive melody notes: m/M 2nd–7th, P4, P5 or octave

tests.zh: 看樂譜、聽兩次(旋律改了節奏和音高):各改在第幾小節
tests.en: With the score: bar of the rhythm change and of the pitch change (melody line)

grades.params: 有和聲、8 小節、大調、2/3/4/6 拍

tests.zh: 聽兩次:(i) 拍號;(ii) 力度;(iii) 奏法
tests.en: (i) Time signature; (ii) dynamics; (iii) articulation

tests.zh: 聽兩次:說出並評論曲子另外兩個特徵
tests.en: Identify and comment on two other characteristics

tests.zh: 聽前四小節:轉到下屬調、屬調還是關係小調
tests.en: First four bars: modulation to subdominant, dominant or relative minor?

tests.zh: 看樂譜、聽兩次,旋律有兩處改變:找出位置並說是音高還是節奏
tests.en: With the score, two changes in the melody: locate each, pitch or rhythm

grades.params: 有和聲、8 小節、大調或小調、2/3/4/6 拍
grades.paramsEn: Harmonised · 8 bars · major or minor · 2, 3, 4 or 6 time

tests.zh: 聽兩次:(i) 拍號;(ii) 力度;(iii) 奏法
tests.en: (i) Time signature; (ii) dynamics; (iii) articulation

tests.zh: 聽兩次:說出並評論曲子另外兩個特徵
tests.en: Identify and comment on two other characteristics

tests.zh: 聽前四小節:轉到下屬調、屬調還是關係調
tests.en: First four bars: modulation to subdominant, dominant or relative key?

tests.zh: 看樂譜、聽兩次,有三處改變:找出位置並說是音高(只在旋律)還是節奏
tests.en: With the score, three changes: locate each, pitch (melody only) or rhythm

grades.paramsEn: Harmonised · 12–16 bars · major or minor · 2, 3, 4, 6 or 5 time

tests.zh: 聽一次:(i) 拍號;(ii) 力度;(iii) 奏法
tests.en: Heard once: (i) time signature; (ii) dynamics; (iii) articulation

tests.zh: 聽兩次:說出並評論曲子另外三個特徵
tests.en: Identify and comment on three other characteristics

tests.zh: 看樂譜、聽兩次,有三處改變:找出位置並說是音高還是節奏
tests.en: With the score, three changes: locate each, pitch or rhythm
